digest: HEAD 654f639 touches the stop/cancel/terminal-summary code in src/; the code contradicts SPEC.md in several places (poll default, cancellation keywords, stop-error detection, launchRetries rename) and no unit tests exist. Scope is changed-file-level only; the diff itself could not be read.
changeSummary: Commit 654f639 ('stop: poll less often; treat cancelled/timeout as cancellation; shorter retry field name') changes the workflow stop-detection poll interval, widens provider cancellation detection to 'cancelled' and 'timeout', and renames the terminal summary field launchRetryAttempts to launchRetries. The committed SPEC.md (added in 11bc671) still specifies the old behavior.

changeInputs.note: commit message: 'stop: poll less often; treat cancelled/timeout as cancellation; shorter retry field name'
